content.text: : potent inhibitors of bone resorption; bind to hydroxyapatite crystals in bone & antagonize osteoclast activity; osteoclast activate, form, & recruitment are inhibited, & life span = ↓; increase osteoblast prolif & intestinal calcium absorb
: first line tx/prev of OP in most pts
: esophagitis, MSK sxs, hypocalcemia, GI (PO) – abd pain, dyspepsia, N/V, dysphagia, heartburn
: osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ), atypical femur frx – limit tx to 3-5yrs in pts w/ ↓risk of frx
: caution in pts w/ aspirin-sensitive asthma – can induce bronchoconstrict
•Estrogen Agonist: bone (↓ resorption), lipids, coag system
•Estrogen Antagonist: breast, uterus (↓ risk of breast CA & endometrial CA)
: tx or prev in postmenopausal women
: vasomotor sxs (hot flashes), GU atrophy, periph edema, arthralgia, leg cramps/musc spasms, flu sxs, infect
: stimulates osteoblast funct, increases GI calcium absorb, and increases renal tubular reabsorb of calcium
: used in pts w/ a ↑risk of frx for up to 2yrs
: arthralgias, leg cramps, pain, nausea, dizziness/orthostasis
: osteosarcoma – dep on dose/duration of tx
: RANKL inhibitor – results in ↓bone resorption & ↑bone mass & strength
: used for tx when there = a ↑risk of frx in pts who cannot adhere to or tolerate PO bisphos
: serious systemic/skin infect, dermatologic rxns (derm, eczema, rashes), ONJ
: monoclonal Ab that inhibits sclerostin, w the net effects of increasing bone form and decreasing bone resorption (lesser effect)
: OP tx in postmenopausal women @ ↑risk for frx or failed/intolerant to other therapy
: potential risk of MI, CVA, & CV death

: functionally antagonizes the effects of PTH; directly inhibits osteoclastic bone resorption; promotes the renal excretion of calcium, phosphate, sodium, magnesium, and potassium by decreasing tubular reabsorb; increases the jejunal secretion of H2O, sodium, potassium, and Cl

: last line therapy/⍉recommended – used for pts who cannot tolerate or fail alendronate or raloxifene therapy; only recommended as a tx option for women >5yr postmenopausal who cannot tolerate any other OP med
: back pain, myalgia, nausea, dizziness, inj (flushing & inj site rxns)
: hypocalcemia (assoc w/ tetany/sz), ↑risk of malig w/ long-term use, hypersensitivity to salmon-derived prod, Ab form, nasal spray (nasal ulcerations, epistaxis, rhinitis)
